faq.q: What is the origin of Nilufer?
faq.a: Nilufer is associated with Persian. Nilufer is Persian نیلوفر (nīlūfar), meaning 'water lily'. It is used as a female given name in Iran and Turkey.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Nilufer can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nilufer should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nīlūfar is a Persian word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
